'''Arctic Trooper Armor'''<ref name="Reveal">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20191022-0|text=Cartel Market Newest Additions: Available Now!}}</ref> was a type of specialized cold-weather body [[Armor/Legends|armor]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /> used around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[October 22]], [[2019]].<ref name="Reveal" /> It was heavily inspired by the [[Canon]] [[vambrace armor]] worn by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[range trooper]]s,<ref name="TOG">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]''</ref> first appearing in [[2018]]'s ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>
